entries.title: Psalms 26:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Vindicate me, O LORD, For I have walked in my integrity. I have also trusted in the LORD; I shall not slip.

entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; Try my mind and my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 26:3
segments: For Your lovingkindness [is] before my eyes, And I have walked in Your truth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments: I have not sat with idolatrous mortals, Nor will I go in with hypocrites.

entries.title: Psalms 26:5
segments: I have hated the assembly of evildoers, And will not sit with the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments: ¶I will wash my hands in innocence; So I will go about Your altar, O LORD,

entries.title: Psalms 26:7
segments: That I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving, And tell of all Your wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: LORD, I have loved the habitation of Your house, And the place where Your glory dwells.

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Do not gather my soul with sinners, Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,

entries.title: Psalms 26:10
segments: In whose hands [is] a sinister scheme, And whose right hand is full of bribes.

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; Redeem me and be merciful to me.

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: My foot stands in an even place; In the congregations I will bless the LORD.
